nodes_add.name: Shri Hit Gaurangi Sharan Ji Maharaj
nodes_add.note: Radhavallabh renunciant of Vrindavan; guru of Premanand Maharaj, who served him about ten years and received from him initiation into sahachari bhav and nitya vihar ras (ashram's account). Dates not found.

nodes_add.name: Hit Mohit Maral Goswami
nodes_add.note: 18th Tilakayat Adhikari (head) of the Radhavallabh Sampradaya, Radhavallabh temple, Vrindavan, per the temple site; eldest son of the 17th, Hit Radhesh Lal Goswami. By Premanand's ashram's account he gave Premanand the sect's sharanagat mantra and sent him to Gaurangi Sharan. Birth year not given.

nodes_update.name: Premanand Maharaj
nodes_update.note: Shri Hit Premanand Govind Sharan Ji Maharaj; born Aniruddh Kumar Pandey, Akhri village, Sarsaul block, Kanpur district, UP. Birth year 1969 (NavbharatLive), 30 Mar 1971 (Wikipedia) or 1972 (Pioneer); 1971 used for the node, flag as uncertain. Left home at 13; naishthik brahmachari (Anandswaroop Brahmachari), sannyasa as Swami Anandashram; Varanasi ghats; Vrindavan (about two decades before 2025 per ThePrint); Shri Hit Radha Keli Kunj, Varaha Ghat. Living.

edges_upsert.note: Member of the Radhavallabh Sampradaya; ashram, Wikipedia and ThePrint agree.
Named as his guru (sadguru) by his ashram and by ThePrint (2025); about ten years' service. Date unknown. Verified that he and his ashram state it; no independent record.
Ashram biography: gave him the sharanagat mantra at the Radhavallabh temple before sending him to Gaurangi Sharan. Date unknown.
Hereditary head (Tilakayat) of the sect, per radhavallabhmandir.com.

places.name: Shri Hit Radha Keli Kunj, Varaha Ghat, Vrindavan
places.what: His ashram on the Parikrama Marg, where he holds satsang and Ekantik Vartalap sessions. Coordinates are for Vrindavan town to two decimals; exact site not checked.

places.name: Radhavallabh temple, Vrindavan
places.what: Where, by the ashram's account, he was drawn into the Radhavallabh Sampradaya and received its initiation mantra. Town-level coordinates.

places.name: Assi Ghat, Varanasi
places.what: Among the Ganga ghats where he lived as a young renunciant.

glossary.def: Repeating the name of God, aloud or silently, as a practice in itself. Premanand Maharaj's central instruction. (Overlaps the existing entries Japa and Naam; merge if preferred.)

Literally a private conversation. At Premanand Maharaj's ashram, a short session in which written questions from a small admitted audience are read out and he answers them; recordings are posted online.
Taking refuge; full surrender of oneself to God or the guru, leaving the outcome of one's life to them.
In the Radhavallabh tradition, the inner attitude of one of Radha's companions, who lives for the happiness of the divine couple.
The eternal love play of Radha and Krishna in Vrindavan, which the Radhavallabh devotee hopes to witness as a companion.
Love; in the Radhavallabh Sampradaya, pure selfless love, and a prefix to the names of its founder Hit Harivansh and many of its teachers.
Living on small portions of food begged from several households, like a bee gathering from many flowers; a traditional renunciant's discipline in Braj.
One who takes a vow of lifelong celibacy and study, without later marrying.

issues: premanand-maharaj.mdx: birth year conflicts (1969 NavbharatLive; 30 March 1971 Wikipedia; 1972 Pioneer). Glance gives all three; node uses 1971 provisionally. No primary record found.

premanand-maharaj.mdx: dates of leaving Varanasi, arriving in Vrindavan and the two initiations are undocumented. ThePrint's 'two decades ago' (2025) sits awkwardly with ten years' service to his guru before teaching, and with Mohit Maral Goswami being the current head (succeeded his father recently per the temple site); the ashram account may mean he received the mantra from the Goswami family. Left as the ashram's account.

premanand-maharaj.mdx: kidney illness kept to one sentence (his own public statements; Pioneer column; Wikipedia citing India Today and Indian Express, which could not be fetched here). Author may prefer to drop it under the living-person rule.

premanand-maharaj.mdx: the July 2025 remarks are known mostly from a short clip; sources fetched (Madhyamam, Dynamite News, Amar Ujala) paraphrase in English or Hindi and none gives a full transcript. No apology or clarification by him or the ashram was found. A national paper of record (Indian Express, The Hindu, NDTV English) could not be fetched; checker should confirm.
premanand-maharaj.mdx: Ankita Lokhande's support rests on an Aaj Tak web story headline seen in search results only, not fetched.
premanand-maharaj.mdx: ThePrint follower figures (30M Instagram, 14M YouTube, August 2025) are dated and will age; consider updating at publication.

premanand-maharaj.mdx: the night walk's later history after July 2024 (resumed, timing changed, postponed for health) is summarised loosely from Zee and NavbharatLive search results; exact dates not established.
premanand-maharaj.mdx: no photo added. Media cards not used (profile template); the Bhajan Marg YouTube channel URL is from the ashram site.
Hit Harivansh dates: Wikipedia 1502-1552 with founding 1535; Jagadananda Das (BSOAS 1992) 1502-1553. Profile gives founding as 'usually dated 1535'.

grace.mdx: names only Part 7 figures with pages (Anandamayi Ma, Prabhupada, Bhaktivinoda, Bhaktisiddhanta, Amma, Shastriji Maharaj, Papa Ramdas, Neem Karoli Baba, Premanand Maharaj). Ramakrishna, Sarada Devi, Vallalar, Ayya Vaikundar and Shirdi Sai Baba sit in other parts in graph.json and are not named. Mother Meera and Gaur Gopal Das are Part 7 tree nodes without pages and are not named.
Places: Vrindavan coordinates are town-level only (verified: false); exact coordinates for Radha Keli Kunj and the Radhavallabh temple need checking. Akhri village not mapped.

premanand-maharaj: Birth name Aniruddh Kumar Pandey; Akhri village, Sarsaul block, Kanpur; Brahmin family; grandfather a sannyasi; father Shambhu Pandey later took sannyasa; mother Rama Devi; read Shri Sukhsagar in class 5; told mother by class 9; left home at 13 at 3 a.m.; Anandswaroop Brahmachari; Swami Anandashram; akash vritti; Assi Ghat and ghats Haridwar-Varanasi; blessed by Shiva; month of Ras Lila and Chaitanya lila; train to Mathura; Banke Bihari; sent to Radhavallabh temple; Mohit Maral Goswami gave Sharanagat mantra; met Gaurangi Sharan; sahachari bhav and nitya vihar ras; served guru 10 years; madhukari -> https://radhakelikunj.com/?p=269

Born 30 March 1971; naishthik brahmachari; Shiva vision in Varanasi directed him to Vrindavan; Radhavallabh founded by Hit Harivansh; Radha Keli Kunj at Varaha Ghat on Parikrama Marg; Shri Hit Radha Keli Kunj Trust; satsang 4:15-5:45 AM; Ekantik Vartalap; ADPKD and dialysis; declined donation offers -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Premanand_Govind_Sharan
Born 1969 -> https://navbharatlive.com/religion/premanand-govind-sharan-ji-maharaj-vrindavan-wale-real-name-know-unknown-facts-full-biograph-1119198.html

Born 1972 in Akhari; kidneys failed, dialysis; says he lives by Radha's will; does not offer quick fixes, blessing will not cure body pain; rejects superstition -> https://dailypioneer.com/news/delving-into-indias-faith-faultlines (opinion column, 13 Sep 2026)

Left home at 13 ('he left his home at the age of 13 to pursue sanyas'); quote 'one among thousands of other sants in the holy town' (arrival two decades before 2025); guru Shri Hit Gaurangi Sharan Ji Maharaj; Ekantik Vartalaap by free token, written questions read by a sevak, 12-15 minute sessions; 30M+ Instagram, 14M+ YouTube; 8 lakh+ on Nirjala Ekadashi June 2025; Kohli and Sharma among visitors; quote 'only naam jaap' (recommends only naam jaap as a solution); denounces meat and alcohol; supports love and inter-caste marriages, parents should support children -> https://theprint.in/ground-reports/sets-premanand-maharaj-apart-doesnt-sell-miracles-celebrity-favourite/2722838/ (18 Aug 2025)
Bhajan Marg YouTube channel URL; Shri Hit Radha Keli Kunj Trust -> https://radhakelikunj.com/
Hit glossed as pure love; sahachari as companion of the divine couple -> https://radhakelikunj.com/?p=267

Night walk from residence on Chhatikara road to Radha Keli Kunj at 2:15 a.m. halted after Hathras stampede, 4 July 2024 -> https://www.amarujala.com/uttar-pradesh/mathura/saint-premanand-stopped-night-marchin-mathura-after-hathras-incident-2024-07-04
